author: Act for freedom now!
title: SOLIDARITY TO THE PERSECUTED, REVENGE FOR THE MURDER BY COPS: FROM BERLIN TO GREECE
content:
Reposting from de.indymedia, a statement of solidarity from Berlin:

SOLIDARITY TO OUR ARRESTED COMRADES IN ATHENS, CHANIA AND THESSALONIKI

REVENGE FOR THE MURDER OF THE 20 YEAR-YOUNG THODORIS ZAVRADINOS-KARAMPAMPAS BY THE COPS

In the last days the greek government has been unfolding a massive attack against the anarchist movement and all those parts of society who are struggling for a just and dignified life, against those opposing the death policies of the state.

On Friday 10.07, the police undertook a coordinated operation against anarchists in Athens, Chania and Thessaloniki, arresting comrades both in the occasion of the arson attacks on Nea Demokratia politicans cars in Thessaloniki, and reopening the investigations in the MARFIN case.

In 2010 in Athens during the general strike against the memorandum, a bank of MARFIN was burned and 3 workers inside the bank died from the fire. Already back then this was used by the state to unleash a massive anti-terrorism witch-hunt, during which 3 comrades were imprisoned for 3 to 5 years, under fabricated evidence that later could not be upheld in the court.

Now, 16 years later (!), the state is reopening this case, again using fabricated information and reheating the same old arguments, as how anarchists are criminals who kill and plant bombs. It’s a narrative trying to depoliticise and criminalise the anarchist struggle.

author: Act for freedom now!
title: In Contempt #8: State Terror in Prairieland, Minneapolis, Michigan, & Elsewhere, Repression Breeds Resistance…But Only If We Try!
content:
link: https://incontempt.noblogs.org/2026/06/30/in-contempt-8/

In a climate of escalating repression and social war, we return with another round-up of updates and calls to action about political prisoners, repression of revolutionaries, and rebellions behind bars.

The US state’s recent attacks on anarchists and anti-authoritarians, framing the militant forefront of mass resistance to fascism as “terrorism” is nothing new––it is the foundational repressive arm of US state capitalist terror that seeks to maintain its imperial and national domination at all costs. From Haymarket to the Anarchist Exclusion Act, from the Sedition Act to Sacco and Vanzetti, from Red Scares to COINTELPRO, from the MOVE bombing to Wounded Knee, from the Green Scare to J20, and now from Prairieland to Minneapolis, any threat to the state in the vast social war of the exploited against their exploiters will encounter repression. Repression is inevitable in any struggle for liberation. Repression––whether the forceful imposition of prison or death or our own fears that keep us from acting––is but one obstacle on the path to freedom. Understanding––and confronting––repression in this way will not demobilize us, scare us, or terrorize us. Resistance is never impossible, and despite the severe constraints of state terror we will understand, too, that the best way to fight repression is to fight.

author: Act for freedom now!
title: Froges (Isère): Cutting Off Power to Semiconductor Factories (France)
content:
Cutting Off Power to Semiconductor Factories

Claim of Attack on Pylons Targeting STM and Soitec: Water and Stars, Not Chips and Nuclear Power!

Earlier this week, we attacked two pylons on the high-voltage lines that supply the Froges substation (in the Grésivaudan region).

This substation supplies electricity to the STMicroelectronics and Soitec semiconductor factories. We sawed through the bases of these pylons, but they remained standing despite our efforts to bring them down and cause a power outage.

RTE, these lines must be de-energized immediately!!

Our sabotage is part of a broader struggle against the techno-industrial system. We take this opportunity to salute the marchers in Grenoble, to show them that there are many of us who oppose their world of microchips, alienation, and the destruction of life.

Direct action! Solidarity! Resistance!

title: THE STATE’S FRAME-UP WILL FAIL HANDS OFF OUR COMRADES (Greece)
content:
May 5, 2010, has been etched into Greeek society’s memory as a day of widespread social revolt, a day that condensed a vast wave of resistance to and rejection of the austerity regime imposed through the memoranda. It is a day that the political and economic bosses, the state and capital, are trying to bury and erase from the movement’s historical memory.

Sixteen years later, the state gang of the unrepentant is pulling a closed case back out of the drawer—a case that resulted in the conviction of the employers—and launching yet another witch hunt. Selectively and hypocritically exploiting the current circumstances, following the recent developments in Thessaloniki, they are attempting to conflate unrelated events, sixteen years apart, linked only by their association with anarchist activity.

Thus, on July 10, yet another pogrom began, with raids on comrades’ homes and the arrest of two of them, while an arrest warrant was issued for another person who has lived abroad for years. They are reviving the narrative of terrorism in order to change the agenda, amid government discussions about early elections, in an attempt to distract society.

They speak about the value of human life. But do all lives count equally?

title: Camover Communique #1: LVT Camera Tower Smashed! (Portland,USA)
content:
Early in the morning on July 1st, four Anarchists set out with hammers, a knife, and a 30′ trucker strap, to flip over and destroy a LiveView Technologies Camera Tower on Willamette Blvd in Portland. LVT, along with Flock, Axon, Ring, Waymo, Tesla, and Google, are leading the way in “AI” equipped surveillance tools, tightening the net of surveillance while finding a way to market your every move. We crept through the night and hid in the shadows for a few minutes, analyzing traffic and watching bunnies hop through the grass, indulging in their nightly play. When we felt confident, we approached the tower and found it easy to climb and wrap the rope 3/4 of the way up. Several cars passed us by, but despite being right on the shoulder, no one seemed to notice or care! We tugged and tugged with all our might, but unfortunately, 30′ did not lend enough leverage to upend the tower.

Yet all was not lost! After three minutes of trying to flip it, we gave up and instead climbed all the way to the top of the tower. This is not super easy, but can be done by anyone with a slight climbing competency. At the top we were able to smash all the cameras, while friends on the ground slashed all of the tires, and smashed all of the solar panels, leaving the tower immobile and inoperable! title: Nort-sur-Erdre (Loire-Atlantique): Concrete Mixer Trucks Go Up in Smoke (France)
content:
Four concrete mixer trucks set on fire at a company near
Nantes; an investigation has been launched

During the night of Saturday, May 23, around 4:30 a.m., the gendarmerie was alerted to a fire involving concrete mixer trucks in Nort-sur-Erdre, near Nantes. “‘I heard two loud booms,’” explains a resident of the hamlet of La Verrière, who lives about one kilometer as the crow flies from Rue d’Anjou, where four concrete mixer trucks were on fire. The explosions were likely caused by bursting tires or fuel tanks on the vehicles.

This Friday, May 29, trucks blackened by flames are parked in the lot of Bétons Manufacturés de l’Erdre (BME Guimard Bétons), a family-owned business that has been manufacturing and delivering ready-mix concrete for over 40 years. “Forensic investigators have documented the scene,” states the gendarmerie, which is taking this fire very seriously, given the context of opposition against land development.

The ongoing investigation has been entrusted to the Ancenis Criminal Investigation Unit and the Nort-sur-Erdre Independent Unit.

Claim of sabotage – Spring of Local Struggles

title: CALL FOR WEEK OF ACTION AGAINST THE GERMAN STATE
content:
To be clear: fascism is here. It’s time to stop moving through life and feeling like we’re seeing ghosts. Fascism is firmly rooted in the present status quo, and uprooting is our business.

On September 6th, federal state elections will be held in Sachsen-Anhalt, an AfD stronghold. Many signs are pointing towards the party gaining an absolute majority. We are tired of discussing harm reduction, strategic voting or so-called democratic practices in general. Whether the AfD will win or not, we know that current authoriatian powers all over the western world are preparing for fascism and war. And Germany plays a major role in this.
Demonstrations, human chains and petitions won’t change the system, we have to find other ways to act.

The German state is three years away from the next general elections, and people living there need to prepare for an AfD-led government. We want to talk about and practice what we need to do to destroy the workings of the state.

From an anarchist point of view, it may come as surprise that we are calling for this week of action. We don’t want to fall into blind actionism orienting itself along parliamentary politics too much. However, we have decided that now is a good moment to draw a line. There is plenty of reasons to attack the German state.

author: Act for freedom now!
title: 10 Years on the Road – A Hug From Clandestinity
content:
From the Nowhere I hold you close to my heart and want you to know that, for the most part, I’m doing well! Unfortunately, the last few days have been a bit tough, as this anniversary kept catapulting me back to that day when I had to leave you all behind. Buried feelings resurfaced as a result of my vivid visualization of those times. It’s been 10 years… And even though time is an illusion, I keep falling back into believing in it. But now, as I write these lines to you, the past is peeling away from the old facade, and a gust of wind sweeps the future away. I am with you, whether Here or There. And there is nothing that can sever this connection.

Ten years ago, I made the decision to set out on a journey to preserve my freedom. And this freedom allowed me to explore life in all its social and cultural diversity, thereby gaining a better understanding of myself and growing from it. An endeavor that is well worth the price I’ve paid!

I can’t even express how much I’m looking forward to seeing you all again. It’s going to be wonderful. Until then, let’s stay apart, yet remain close in spirit.

Your friend and comrade from Nowhere

title: Nationwide Outages Due to Fire at Almere Data Center (NL)
content:
The fire broke out at 8:45 a.m. in the data center’s technical room, says Director Alexandra Schless. The NorthC Data Center houses servers on which national and international clients can store their IT environments.

Multiple Organizations Affected

The fire at the data center caused many websites and other services to go down. Because the power has been shut off, organizations whose platforms are hosted in Almere cannot use their systems. Among others, Statistics Netherlands (CBS), the transportation company TransDev, and Utrecht University are affected. The university, which has faced severe protests in the last years due to it’s ties with israel, took ten whole days to get its systems back up and running…

The cause of the fire is not yet known. According to the data center, the investigation has not yet been completed.

author: Act for freedom now!
title: “The Leeches that Steal its Soul”: A Response to “Goodnight Eurocentric Pride”
content:
“Just as we arm our hands to strengthen our blows, we must also fortify our minds. Our imagination, nourished by memories of resistance that has come before, bolstered by a precise projectuality, sharpened by critical thinking and corrosive insight, proves to be an arsenal of choice. […] Obviously there is no shortage of military and political campaigns against existing powers to inspire those who don’t concern themselves with ethical and practical coherence, dismissed as an excess of purism, but there is also no scarcity of revolts against the long conquest of domination over life. And while the tension towards freedom transcends all “isms,” for anarchists, the two-fold challenge is to both grasp the particularities of our contexts with realism and draw on historical experiences that resonate with our uncompromising ideals.”
–History Drowned in Lethe
There was a world in which I was tempted to be charitable to the author of “Good Night Eurocentric Pride“. The article in Tinderbox #9 which it is criticizing certainly had a limitation. On the one hand, it calls us towards a profoundly difficult task: to separate ourselves from the heavy legacy of organized confusion in which revolt has been conflated with its enemies. author: Act for freedom now!
title: Mischievous Evening Jaunt (USA)
content:
June 30, 2026
Recently during a warm evening jaunt we sabotaged an automated license plate reader, an indigo bike station, some construction machinery, and painted over or disabled around 20 camera.
We want to highlight some of the tools we used that we think are underappreciated in radical circles. A handheld garden sprayer filled with watered down paint was used to paint a lot of the out of reach cameras. It’s smaller, lighter, and easier to use than a fire extinguisher. The license plate reader, other cameras, and the bike station were sabotaged using wire cutters. Exposed wires were snipped and hand tools opened panels when wires were inside cabinets or conduits.
We had an awesome time and enjoyed a fabulous post-crime spree glow in the days that followed!
